_comment: catalog/fly-prices.json — the price table bin/vendor-spend-pull.sh multiplies
Fly machine-seconds by. Fly has NO public billing/usage API (probed
type 'Organization'" and the same for 'invoices'), so the Fly row is
kind=computed and this file is what makes the number reproducible.
DB-DRIVEN, code constant only as a documented fallback (global rules). Edit
THIS file when Fly's list prices move — bin/vendor-spend-pull.sh reads it and
carries no rates of its own except the same-shaped fallback in its header,
used only when this file is missing or unparseable. A row priced from that
fallback says so in its note, so a stale catalog is visible rather than
silently assumed. catalog/model-prices.json is the same pattern one vendor over.
seconds_per_month is 730h, which is the basis Fly's own per-second rates are
quoted against. Volumes are billed on PROVISIONED size, not used bytes.
source: https://fly.io/docs/about/pricing/ — published list prices, read by hand
